sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Candidate faithfully targets ships, applies the exact contract-date interval, and conditionally requires presence of nltl:iceClassRegulationEdition2017 without incorrectly prohibiting additional edition values.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Correct the lower applicability bound: the current YEAR/MONTH/DAY expression excludes contract dates in January 2019 after 1 January. Encode the interval exactly as contractDate >= "2019-01-01"^^xsd:date and contractDate < "2021-07-05"^^xsd:date (or an equivalent inclusive lower-bound expression), while retaining the conditional requirement for applicableIceClassRegulationEdition to be iceClassRegulationEdition2017.

Retain the corrected applicability interval, but remove the EXISTS branch that rejects any additional applicableIceClassRegulationEdition value. TRF-002 requires that iceClassRegulationEdition2017 be present for ships in the date interval; it does not declare an exclusive-property group or prohibit other values. Make the conditional violation solely the absence of nltl:iceClassRegulationEdition2017.

Candidate faithfully targets ships, applies the exact contract-date interval, and conditionally requires presence of nltl:iceClassRegulationEdition2017 without incorrectly prohibiting additional edition values.
